710450101.text: It's great to see that you're alright! What... what were those two creatures? I've never seen anyone... or anything like that... *cough*

710450102.text: Alright, alright, there's no need to be so strict. I won't risk provoking them, I know...

710450103.text: How did you get in front of us?

710450104.text: We came through a hidden mine on the western side that just so happens to let us get around the areas infested with the black matter and the strange creatures below... *cough* Ugh...

710450106.text: I'm fine, I'm fine... That road was pretty hard to find. It might've been some sort of path the Treasure Hoarders carved out en route to their loot stashes... But I can't imagine them wanting to come this far down, either...

710450107.text: Well, our campsite isn't too far away. Let's talk as we go, shall we?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the camp with Zhiqiong

710450201.text: *cough* Oh, hello there. Is there something you need?

710450202.text: You're coughing away! You sure you're okay?

710450203.text: I'm alright, really... The air down here is just kinda thin, which doesn't sit too well with me.

710450204.text: Ah, yes. This is the map that I drew earlier... *cough* *cough* Ugh. Well, that feels better.

710450205.text: Uh, you'd best rest up. Don't go running around all over the place, now!

710450206.text: Speaking of maps, we've got one for you as well...

710450207.text: It's a map of "The Two Strange Bells"... Seems like it's something those dastardly Fatui left behind!

710450208.text: Thank you! I'll incorporate this new location into my map!

710450209.text: ...Wait a moment. Did you say "Fatui"? They've tunneled into this place as well?

710450211.text: Looks like we've got to be even more careful while exploring The Chasm...

710450212.text: Speaking of which, we found this...

710450213.text: You've been around here more, Zhiqiong, so you probably know what this is used for, right?

710450214.text: This? I think I found a gate with a symbol similar to this one somewhere deeper down.

710450215.text: *cough* *cough* Ah, sorry. If I remember correctly, you could hear the wind behind that gate... I'm quite sure that there should be a large open space behind it for us to explore.

710450216.text: I wonder what relationship this thing has to that gate? Might it be a key of some sort? *cough*

710450217.text: Zhiqiong's right. This is a device used to unlock the gate.

710450218.text: Whoa! Where did you come from?

710450219.text: A "hello" before joining the conversation might be nice.

710450220.text: Sorry, um... I was just too eager to say that this strange device is indeed used to open doors.

710450221.text: I once looked into similar devices, and just as luck might have it, the device in your hands is an exact match to the one in my research lab.

710450222.text: Unfortunately, neither alchemy nor basic mechanics can help us understand the energy held within these devices, nor can they explain the principles behind their ability to unlock and lock gates...

710450225.text: We Amurta take a rather dim view of those who rely purely on theory. That said, we often have to work with those blockheads from Spantamad all the same...

710450226.text: *sigh* Well, that's all I can tell you. There isn't much else to be said with regard to the Akademiya...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the gate that Zhiqiong mentioned

710450401.text: (This stone tablet looks a fair bit more recent than the rest of the ruins. It seems to have been set up not long ago.)

710450402.text: (Although the inscription cannot be understood per se, a little observation reveals that the engraving is a map of the surrounding area.)

710450403.text: (The tablet is also engraved with some complex pictures that have something to do with the giant crystal suspended before you...)

710450704.text: *cough* What's wrong? You don't look so good. Did I annoy you in some way?

710450705.text: Y'know, Paimon's having trouble telling who looks worse between the two of you...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go within the gate to investigate
Go within the gate to investigate

710450503.text: There've been several earthquakes ever since you went through that gate. We don't know what's going on down there, but we're glad to see that you're both okay.

710450504.text: Well, you don't look too bad yourself. Looks like the rest helped, eh?

710450505.text: How are things on your end?

710450506.text: I've followed your advice and rested here all this while. I'm feeling a whole lot better now... Was this all due to "that thing" behind the gate?

710450507.text: I didn't go in there, but I could feel some strange pulsing within... Something amazing must have been back there, I'm sure of it...

710450508.text: *cough* I grew up listening to tales of the Yakshas, and some of my seniors used to say that one of them was sealed inside The Chasm and slumbers to this day.

710450510.text: I see... Thank you. So, as for the dark mud we... *cough* Sorry...

710450512.text: So the crystal in the upper levels did fly towards it — a fragment desiring to be part of the whole once again.

710450513.text: So that's the key to solving the mystery of The Chasm... I might go and see it for myself later.

710450514.text: *cough* Thank you. So, as for that dark mud... *cough* Sorry...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go within the gate to investigate

710450325.text: This doesn't look like a natural cave. It looks like something huge cut right through this place instead... Huh. Actually, "rammed right through" might be more accurate.

710450301.text: #Y'know, {NICKNAME}... Don't you think this floating thingy looks rather familiar? This resembles what we saw on top of Dragonspine back then.

710450303.text: Whatever it is, it's really spooky...

710450305.text: Uh, whatever it is, this is pretty creepy...

710450306.text: Y'know, doesn't that stone tablet look kinda new to you? It doesn't look like it fits in with the ruins around it at all!

710450307.text: (Although the inscription cannot be understood per se, a little observation reveals that the engraving is a map of the surrounding area, and that the other pictures have something to do with the floating crystal...)

710450308.text: Hmm, so the big crystal has five weird devices around it, and these lines are connected to the crystal... Gah, Paimon can't read this! Why is this diagram so messy!?

710450309.text: Looks like we need to activate those five devices...

710450310.text: Then, uh, someone needs to hit the crystal or something... and then the black spots will disappear...

710450313.text: After that... Wait a minute, why did they draw this big worm? Hmm... Seems like this stone tablet is telling us to beware of the super big worm.

710451101.text: #Hmm... Looks like we've come to the bit where we've got to "apply some external force to the crystal." You ready, {NICKNAME}?

710451104.text: Well, we've come this far. Let's just give it a shot like we always do, eh?

710451401.text: As the unexpected collapse occurs, you manage to escape to safety in time.

710451402.text: Huh... Is... Is it over? It all kinda feels like a dream...

710451403.text: Looks like that thing up there has gone back to normal. The air feels less heavy, too.

710451404.text: Hmm, even though we've reached the bottom of The Chasm and even defeated the creature down there somehow... But it doesn't feel like we've answered any questions!

710451405.text: In fact, we've got more questions now than we did before!

710451406.text: Like for example... What was that thing above us? Why did a giant serpent come roaring out? Where did that dark mud and the strange monsters come from?

710451407.text: The monsters that followed the dark mud here seemed to be eating at the big crystal, and Zhiqiong mentioned that a Yaksha was here once...

710451408.text: Agh, this is way too many questions for Paimon!

710451409.text: Looks like The Chasm still has many secrets that are yet to be discovered...

710451410.text: Yeah, no wonder adventurers like Zhiqiong are so committed to exploring this place...

710451411.text: But things should quiet down a bit in here now that we've cleared this big thing up, right?

710451412.text: Still looks like a long way off before the mines can reopen...

710451413.text: But our exploration mission seems complete. We'll worry about that other stuff in the future!

710451415.text: It feels like... someone helped us out during that fight with the big snake. Did you hear this "shoom" sound during the fight?

710451418.text: Um... Well, never mind. When we head back, we can ask Zhiqiong if she saw any strangers!

710452503.text: There've been several earthquakes ever since you went through that gate. We don't know what's going on down there, but we're glad to see that you're both okay.

710452504.text: Well, you don't look too bad yourself. Looks like the rest helped, eh?

710452505.text: How are things on your end?

710452506.text: I've followed your advice and rested here all this while. I'm feeling a whole lot better now... Was this all due to "that thing" behind the gate?

710452507.text: I didn't go in there, but I could feel some strange pulsing within... Something amazing must have been back there, I'm sure of it...

710452508.text: *cough* I grew up listening to tales of the Yakshas, and some of my seniors used to say that one of them was sealed inside The Chasm and slumbers to this day.

710452510.text: I see... Thank you. So, as for the dark mud we... *cough* Sorry...

710452513.text: So that's the key to solving the mystery of The Chasm... I might go and see it for myself later.

710452514.text: *cough* Thank you. So, as for that dark mud... *cough* Sorry...

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat the monster lurking in The Chasm's depths
Return to camp and talk to Zhiqiong

710450801.text: #You're back, {NICKNAME}! How did things go? There's good news to be had from underground, I hope?

710450803.text: Hahaha! See what I told you? The exploration team were a reliable lot, and the expedition was bound to be fruitful!

710450804.text: I have received the ore samples and data that Khedive and Jinwu have gathered. The unknown matter is in full retreat, and the geological shifts have largely ceased...

710450805.text: ...It's a good omen indeed. Thanks to your help, the Millelith have also expressed no objections to our plans for further exploration and restoration. In fact, they should be getting ready to descend into the mine themselves...

710450808.text: Hmph, that's right... So, who was the one who was trying their best to prevent us from going down previously, huh?

710450809.text: Uh, hehe... Come on now, there's no need to be so straight about such things.

710450810.text: I mean, I will pay you. And of course, The Chasm Exploration Team will become an official part of Huishan Hall from this day forth!

710450811.text: You need to work on your ability to change the topic...

710450812.text: That's right! But since there's Mora to be had, we'll forgive you this time.

710450813.text: Haha, thank you... And you know, I did get a real earful from the higher-ups myself for letting you go down there without so much as a report back to headquarters...

710450815.text: Yeah, and who would bother coming down here themselves to give you an earful anyway?

710450816.text: You might not believe me... But it was the Yuheng herself. She seemed quite concerned for your safety.

710450817.text: Uh, seriously? So Keqing's been keeping an eye on us this whole time?

710450818.text: Uhh, but the person we met down there didn't look anything like her!
